alpha-feedback.artifactBindingRules: Phase 10 applicability; unbound user evidence is preserved but never contributes to an artifact floor
alpha-feedback.authorityRequirement: an ACTIVE artifact-bound Phase 13 sufficiency policy made by assigned AUTH-ALPHA-PROGRAM
alpha-feedback.conflictSemantics: Phase 12 blockers and cross-source conflicts are preserved; favorable reports never outvote blockers
alpha-feedback.expirySemantics: policy effective/supersession state is evaluated only at the cut's explicit asOf
alpha-feedback.owningPhaseEngine: Phase 12 report/triage/sufficiency and Phase 13 owner policy
alpha-feedback.requiredStatusForAuthorization: SUFFICIENT under an active applicable policy with no blocking Alpha finding
alpha-feedback.revocationSemantics: authority revocation or policy supersession removes contribution at later cuts without rewriting history

hardware.artifactBindingRules: Phase 10 exact-artifact applicability; an observation without verified artifact identity remains observational only
hardware.authorityRequirement: assigned AUTH-HARDWARE and an explicit owner-approved machine/support scope
hardware.conflictSemantics: per-machine/per-dimension results are preserved; contradictions require scoped human review and are never averaged
hardware.expirySemantics: an expiring support policy is evaluated only at the cut's explicit asOf
hardware.intakeContract: Phase 9 hardware HW-NNN contract plus the Phase 8 physical protocol
hardware.requiredStatusForAuthorization: QUALIFIED_FOR_DECLARED_SCOPE under a standing owner-approved support policy
hardware.revocationSemantics: authority or support-policy revocation removes later contribution; original machine evidence remains

second-approval.artifactBindingRules: Phase 10 exact-artifact applicability plus an independently recomputed artifact digest and explicit evidence cut
second-approval.authorityRequirement: assigned AUTH-SECOND-APPROVER, separate from AUTH-KEY and AUTH-RELEASE unless an explicit Phase 13 overlap decision stands
second-approval.conflictSemantics: REJECTED, CONDITIONAL, stale-cut, pre-signing, overlap, supersession, or unresolved blocker prevents contribution
second-approval.expirySemantics: approver assignment, risks, and referenced cut are evaluated only at explicit asOf
second-approval.intakeContract: Phase 9 independent second-approval contract; legacy two-approver records remain readable
second-approval.requiredStatusForAuthorization: APPROVED by a standing independent authority after signing over the relevant cut
second-approval.revocationSemantics: authority revocation or a valid superseding approval removes later contribution without editing the original

security-review.artifactBindingRules: Phase 10 applicability over the Phase 16 identity ceremony; wrong-artifact review DOES_NOT_APPLY
security-review.authorityRequirement: independent reviewer evidence through the Phase 16/11 chain and Phase 13 security authority for dispositions/risks
security-review.conflictSemantics: Phase 11 reconciliation is most-blocking; unresolved Critical or conflicting applicable reviews prevent contribution
security-review.expirySemantics: risk acceptance is evaluated only at the cut's explicit asOf
security-review.intakeContract: Phase 16 receipt/validation delegating through Phase 15 to Phase 9 security-review intake
security-review.owningPhaseEngine: Phase 16 receipt -> Phase 11 reconciliation/gate -> Phase 13 risk/authority
security-review.requiredStatusForAuthorization: Phase 11 security gate SATISFIED with no unresolved conflict or expired risk
security-review.revocationSemantics: authority/risk revocation is effective at later cuts; prior cuts retain the earlier record set

signing.artifactBindingRules: submitted and independently recomputed digests must both equal the exact artifact; signature verification must succeed against it
signing.conflictSemantics: any applicable failed verification, wrong digest, drill, authority failure, or conflicting correction prevents contribution
signing.expirySemantics: signer assignment/certificate expiry is evaluated only at the cut's explicit asOf
signing.intakeContract: Phase 9 signing intake with Phase 17 production-verification fields; private material is forbidden
signing.owningPhaseEngine: Phase 9 immutable intake plus Phase 13 key authority and Phase 17 verification composition
signing.requiredStatusForAuthorization: PRODUCTION_SIGNING VERIFIED for the exact artifact by standing authority
signing.revocationSemantics: signer authority/certificate revocation removes contribution at later cuts; the signing record remains preserved

unknownSourcePolicy: REFUSE; there is no generic-external-evidence fallback
